description: Source code for dev_input handling in Linux, including device enumeration, input event processing, and controller mapping.

classes.name: ControllerTuning
classes.description: Manages key code mappings and controller tuning parameters.

classes.name: DeviceMap
classes.description: Singleton managing device-specific controller tuning configurations.

classes.name: InputDeviceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about input devices, including name, file descriptor, axis info, and tuning.

classes.name: DevInputImpl
classes.description: Implementation of DevInput handling input devices, events, and device enumeration.

classes.name: FdSet
classes.description: Helper class for managing a set of file descriptors for select().

methods.name: GetKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the mapped key code for a given input code.

methods.name: MapKeyCode
methods.description: Maps one key code to another within controller tuning.

methods.name: GetMinimumFlat
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum flat value for axis calibration.

methods.name: SetMinimumFlat
methods.description: Sets the minimum flat value for axis calibration.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DeviceMap.

methods.name: GetControllerTuning
methods.description: Retrieves controller tuning for a specific device name.

methods.name: RegisterControllerTuning
methods.description: Registers a controller tuning for a device name.

methods.name: GetInputDevices
methods.description: Enumerates input devices in /dev/input and opens relevant ones.

methods.name: PollInputEvent
methods.description: Polls a device for an input event.

methods.name: KeyInputToApplicationEvent
methods.description: Converts key input_event to application event.

methods.name: AxisInputToApplicationEvent
methods.description: Converts axis input_event to application event.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes the event wait loop via pipe.
